$comment: NotepadXP build config. WTL is vendored under extern/wtl/include; ATL (atlbase.h/atlwin.h) comes from the MSVC environment (vcvarsall puts ATLMFC\include on INCLUDE). HRC requires /W4 /WX (warnings.as_errors); ATL/WTL header noise is isolated behind src/WtlIncludes.hpp via #pragma warning(push,3). Any warning numbers in 'disabled' are deliberate exceptions.
$pch_note: PCH is disabled: vcbuild compiles the PCH without the project 'defines'/warning flags, which MSVC rejects as inconsistent with the consuming TUs, and it applies /Yu with no force-include. WTL-using TUs include src/WtlIncludes.hpp directly instead.
